scope: Four fresh packaged Linux profiles with explicit local dumps and normal process-tree exit. First two test native dismissal; last two verify native Reopen in an isolated KWin virtual/Xwayland desktop. Final run includes disconnect, reconnect and late-response fixes. All four completed Chromium NetLogs list no URL hosts.

runs.environment: Isolated KWin virtual desktop; Xwayland; private config and DBus; normal app sandbox defaults
Isolated KWin virtual desktop; Xwayland; private config and DBus; normal app sandbox defaults

limitations: One-second editor socket samples and Chromium URLs do not cover all DNS/UDP/payloads or separate OS/DBus services. Native Wayland repetition and broader upload/platform acceptance remain open. Environment/KWallet/VSync warnings and intended renderer-crash diagnostics remain; final run has zero stale-frame send errors. Dumps remain ignored/local.
